# SoraTable

A data table from typed columns and rows, with optional controlled sorting and selection.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | data |
| Import | `import { SoraTable } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraTable from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraTable'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/data/SoraTable.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/data/SoraTable.vue) |
| Generic | `Row extends object` |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` **(required)** | `readonly SoraTableColumn<TRow>[]` |  |  |
| `rows` **(required)** | `readonly TRow[]` |  |  |
| `rowKey` **(required)** | `(keyof TRow & string) \| ((row: TRow) => SoraTableRowKey)` |  | Stable identity of a row: a property name or a function. Never the array index. |
| `caption` | `string` |  | Table caption (its accessible name). |
| `hideCaption` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the caption for assistive technology but hide it visually. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `emptyText` | `string` |  | Text for the empty state. Defaults to the translated "No data to display". |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | `false` | Add a checkbox column bound to `v-model:selected`. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `striped` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

## Models

| v-model | Type |  | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:sort` | `SoraTableSort \| null` | default `null` | Controlled sort state. The table never reorders `rows` itself. |
| `v-model:selected` | `SoraTableRowKey[]` | default `() => []` | Keys of the selected rows. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cell` | `props: { row: Row; column: SoraTableColumn<Row>; value: unknown; index: number }` | Any cell. `cell-<key>` slots take precedence for their column. |
| `header` | `props: { column: SoraTableColumn<Row> }` | Header content of any column. |
| `empty` |  | Replaces the empty state. |
| `cell-<key>` | `props: { row: Row; column: SoraTableColumn<Row>; value: unknown; index: number }` | One slot per key; takes precedence over the generic slot. |

## Attributes

The scroll wrapper `<div>`.

## Keyboard

- Sortable headers are buttons (Enter/Space) that cycle ascending, descending, none.
- Selection uses checkboxes (Space).
- When the table overflows, the wrapper becomes a focusable region that scrolls with the arrow keys.

## Accessibility

- Real table markup (`<table>`, `<caption>`, `<th scope>`); no grid role, because it is not an interactive grid.
- `aria-sort` on sortable headers; `aria-busy` and a status message while loading.
- Row checkboxes are named after the row header cell.

## Styling

- `.sora-table-wrap`, `.sora-table`, `.sora-table__cell`, `.sora-table__row`, `.sora-table__sort`
- `data-size`, `data-striped`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/DataDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/DataDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid gap-3">
  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
    <SoraButton size="sm" variant="outline" color="neutral" @click="reload">{{
      t('demo.loading')
    }}</SoraButton>
    <SoraButton
      size="sm"
      variant="outline"
      color="neutral"
      :aria-pressed="empty"
      @click="empty = !empty"
      >{{ t('table.empty') }}</SoraButton
    >
  </div>
  <SoraTable
    v-model:sort="sort"
    v-model:selected="selected"
    :columns="columns"
    :rows="rows"
    row-key="id"
    :caption="t('demo.table.caption')"
    :loading="loading"
    selectable
    data-testid="demo-table"
  >
    <template #cell-name="{ row }">
      <span class="flex items-center gap-2"><SoraAvatar :name="row.name" size="sm" />{{ row.name }}</span>
    </template>
    <template #cell-role="{ row }">
      <SoraBadge :color="row.role === 'owner' ? 'secondary' : 'neutral'">{{
        t(`settings.role.${row.role}`)
      }}</SoraBadge>
    </template>
  </SoraTable>
  <p class="text-sora-sm text-sora-muted" data-testid="table-selected">
    {{ t('demo.selected', { value: selected.join(', ') || '—' }) }}
  </p>
</div>
```
